primary_title: A high endothelial venule-expressing promiscuous chemokine receptor DARC can bind inflammatory, but not lymphoid, chemokines and is dispensable for lymphocyte homing under physiological conditions
decision_basis: The reviews identify CXCL1 as a strong ACKR1/DARC-binding chemokine; the cited primary competitive-binding study detects selective CXCL1 binding to DARC and distinguishes it from non-binding lymphoid chemokines.
limitations_preserved: Record as atypical DARC/ACKR1 binding-only evidence; preserve inflammatory-chemokine selectivity and no canonical G-protein or CNS/SCI claim.

primary_title: The dimeric form of CXCL12 binds to atypical chemokine receptor 1
decision_basis: The reviews identify dimeric CXCL12 as an ACKR1/DARC ligand; the cited primary study shows low-nanomolar dimeric CXCL12 binding to the ACKR1 N-terminus and uptake by transfected MDCK cells and Duffy-positive erythrocytes, whereas monomeric CXCL12 binds weakly.
limitations_preserved: Preserve dimeric ligand state, N-terminal ACKR1 binding and erythrocyte internalization; monomeric CXCL12 is not equivalent, and no canonical G-protein or CNS/SCI claim is made.
